checks.name: Initial setup in packaged production UI
Consecutive settings saves refresh the editing revision
Duplicate account error keeps the form and entered values
Backup restore UI preserves accounts and restores linked records
Invalid resident period is rejected without losing the editing form
Balanced batch UI splits new residents into both meeting groups
Two users cannot overwrite resident changes and the losing edit remains
Stale office settings are protected and explicit reload permits retry
Own password change signs out cleanly and the new password works
Production UI has no unexpected page or console errors
